atoms.b: In ancient Greece, ((++childhood holiday)) was a very difficult time! Children faced ((++strict relaxed)) discipline and high expectations from a very early age.
((++Boys Girls)) were strongly preferred over girls because in most city-states only sons could inherit property and contribute as ((++citizens criminals)) and soldiers.

atoms.text: Knucklebones was an ancient Greek game played using the ankle bones of sheep. Children tossed the bones in various skilful ways to score points.
Knucklebones were also sometimes used in fortune telling, linking the game to the spiritual world.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation between a child from Athens and a child from Sparta.

atoms.b: I go to school every day to learn reading and ((++writing typing)). What about you?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>I go to school every day to learn reading and writing. What about you?</prosody>

atoms.b: I don’t spend a lot of time in a classroom. My school is called an agoge, and we ((++train paint)) to be strong warriors!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>I don’t spend a lot of time in a classroom. My school is called an agogay, and we train to be strong warriors!</prosody>

atoms.b: That sounds exhausting! We do physical training in the school ((++gymnasium cafeteria)) too, but I prefer music and ((++philosophy computing)).
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>That sounds exhausting! We do physical training in the school gymnasium too, but I prefer music and philosophy.</prosody>

atoms.b: In Sparta, boys don’t waste time on ((++music sports)). We practise survival skills, battle tactics and using ((++weapons instruments)). Even my sister trains to be strong!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>In Sparta, boys don’t waste time on music. We practise survival skills, battle tactics and using weapons. Even my sister trains to be strong!</prosody>

atoms.b: My sister stays at home and learns how to ((++cook code)) with my mum. Girls in Athens don’t go to school like we do.
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>My sister stays at home and learns how to cook with my mum. Girls in Athens don’t go to school like we do.</prosody>

atoms.b: That’s so strange! Spartan girls exercise a lot so they can be strong ((++mothers fathers)). The stronger they are, the ((++stronger weaker)) their children will be!
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>That’s so strange! Spartan girls exercise a lot so they can be strong mothers. The stronger they are, the stronger their children will be!</prosody>

atoms.b: I don’t think I’d last a day in a Spartan school...
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-0.5st'>I don’t think I’d last a day in a Spartan school ...</prosody>
